mapper.select: {CALL PROC_CUST_AD_LIST( #{search_type1}, #{search_type2}, #{search_type3}, #{search_type4}, #{search_type5}, #{search_type6}, #{search_type7}, #{search_type8}, #{search_type9}, #{search_text}, #{pageType}, #{startRow}, #{endRow}, #{search_type15}, #{OUTCURSOR, mode=OUT, jdbcType=CURSOR, javaType=java.sql.ResultSet, resultMap=custResultMap})}

SELECT T1.RECV_CUST_CD AS CUST_CD , T1.RECV_CUST_NM AS CUST_NM , T4.BASE_CD_NM AS ITEM_GRP1_NM , T2.ITEM_CD , T3.ITEM_NM , T1.ISSUE_DT , SUM(T2.SUPP_WON_AMT) AS SUPP_WON_AMT , SUM(T2.VAT_WON_AMT) AS VAT_WON_AMT , SUM(T2.SUPP_WON_AMT) + SUM(T2.VAT_WON_AMT) AS TOTAL_AMT FROM KYERP.TB_SD_TAX_BILL_MST T1 , KYERP.TB_SD_TAX_BILL_DTL T2 , KYERP.TB_CM_ITEM_MST T3 , KYERP.TB_CM_CODE_DTL T4 , KYERP.TB_SD_SALES_ORDER_MST T6 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.TAX_BILL_NUMB = T2.TAX_BILL_NUMB AND T3.ITEM_CD = T2.ITEM_CD AND T4.BASE_CD_GRP = 'CM0004' AND T4.LANG_CD = 'KO' AND T4.BASE_CD = T3.ITEM_GRP1 AND T1.SALE_TYPE = '00001' AND T3.ITEM_GRP1 = '00002' AND (T1.RECV_CUST_CD = #{erp_code} OR T6.DELIVERY_CUST_CD= #{erp_code}) AND T6.ORDER_NUMB = T2.ORDER_NUMB AND T6.ORDER_NUMB NOT IN ( 'DO201710310035' , 'DO201802280014' , 'DO201711300012' , 'DO201711300014' , 'DO201711300011' , 'DO201711300013' , 'DO201710310034' , 'DO201802280016' , 'DO201805020108' , 'DO201802280015' ) GROUP BY T1.RECV_CUST_CD , T1.RECV_CUST_NM , T1.ISSUE_DT , T4.BASE_CD_NM , T2.ITEM_CD , T3.ITEM_NM ORDER BY T1.ISSUE_DT DESC

SELECT A.SEQ as doc_seq , A.CUST_SEQ, A.CRM_CODE as D_CRM_CODE , ( SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD44' AND Z.CODE = A.DOC_TYPE) as D_DOC_TYPE , ( SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = A.DOC_TYPE AND Z.CODE = A.DETAIL_TYPE) as D_DETAIL_TYPE , A.STD_DT as D_STD_DT , A.DOC_COMMENT as D_DOC_COMMENT , NVL(( SELECT E.EMP_NM FROM CRM_EMP_MGT E WHERE A.REG_ID = E.EMP_NO), '') as REG_NM, A.REG_ID as D_REG_ID , to_char(A.REG_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:mi:ss') as D_REG_DATE, A.DEL_ID as D_DEL_ID , A.DEL_YN as D_DEL_YN, A.FILE_SEQ, F.ATTACH_SAVE_NM, F.ATTACH_PATH, F.ATTACH_PATH_DTL, F.ATTACH_ORI_NM, F.ATTACH_ORD FROM CRM_CUST_DOC_MGT A, CRM_ATTACH_MGT F WHERE A.CUST_SEQ = #{cust_seq} AND A.FILE_SEQ = F.ATTACH_SEQ ORDER BY SEQ

SELECT COUNT(A.SEQ) FROM CRM_CUST_OPERATE_CHARGE A WHERE 1 =1
AND SEQ IN ( SELECT SEQ FROM CRM_CUST_MGT WHERE CRM_CODE = #{cust_code} )
AND UPPER(A.CHARGE_NM) LIKE '%'|| UPPER(#{search_text}) ||'%'

SELECT OUT_TB.* FROM ( SELECT IN_TB.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY IN_TB.DTL_SEQ ) AS RNUM FROM ( SELECT SEQ , (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD27' AND Z.CODE = CHARGE_CODE) AS CHARGE_CODE , CHARGE_NM, COMPANY_TEL_NO , HP_NO , EMAIL, ETC, DTL_SEQ FROM CRM_CUST_OPERATE_CHARGE ) IN_TB WHERE 1 =1
AND SEQ IN ( SELECT SEQ FROM CRM_CUST_MGT WHERE CRM_CODE = #{cust_code} )
AND UPPER(CHARGE_NM) LIKE '%'|| UPPER(#{search_text}) ||'%'
) OUT_TB WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND #{endRow, jdbcType=INTEGER} ORDER BY RNUM DESC

SELECT X.ERP_CODE, SUBSTR(SALE_DT,1,6) SALE_YM, SUM(NVL(UBO_AMT,0)) UBO_AMT, SUM(NVL(SU_AMT,0)) SU_AMT FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ERP_CODE FROM CRM_CUST_MGT_HIST WHERE CRM_CODE = #{crm_code, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) X, (SELECT CUST_CD,SALE_DT,WON_AMT + VAT_AMT UBO_AMT ,COLL_WON_AMT SU_AMT FROM KYERP.TB_SD_RECEIVABLE_DTL WHERE 1=1 AND CURRENCY = '00001' AND SALE_TYPE = '00001' AND STATUS = '00002' -- 매출확정 AND RV_SLIP_NUMB IS NOT NULL -- 전표발생분
AND ITEM_CD IN('C300000005','C300000005')
AND ITEM_CD IN('C300000001','H000000110')
) Y WHERE X.ERP_CODE = Y.CUST_CD(+)
AND Y.SALE_DT >= #{search_start} || '01'
AND Y.SALE_DT <= #{search_end} || '31'
GROUP BY X.ERP_CODE,SUBSTR(SALE_DT,1,6) ORDER BY 1,2 ASC

mapper.update: MERGE INTO CRM_VIRTUAL_CONTRACT A USING DUAL ON ( A.SEQ = #{seq} ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.CUST_CODE = #{cust_code} , A.CODE_ITEM = #{code_item} , A.SUPP_AMT = #{supp_amt} , A.VAT = #{vat}, A.ST_DATE = #{st_date}, A.END_DATE = #{end_date}, A.GYEYAG_IL = #{gyeyag_il}, A.MEMO = #{memo}, A.REG_ID = #{reg_id} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( A.SEQ, A.CUST_CODE, A.CODE_ITEM, A.SUPP_AMT, A.VAT, A.ST_DATE, A.END_DATE, A.GYEYAG_IL, A.MEMO, A.REG_ID )VALUES( VIRTUAL_CONTRACT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{cust_code}, #{code_item}, #{supp_amt}, #{vat}, #{st_date}, #{end_date}, #{gyeyag_il}, #{memo}, #{reg_id} )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CRM_VIRTUAL_CONTRACT ( SEQ, CUST_CODE, CODE_ITEM, SUPP_AMT, VAT, ST_DATE, END_DATE, GYEYAG_IL, MEMO, REG_ID ) SELECT CM.SEQ ,CM.CUST_CODE ,'C300000001' AS CODE_ITEM ,0 AS SUPP_AMT ,0 AS VAT ,CPM.TERM_END_DT AS ST_DATE ,TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CPM.TERM_END_DT),CPM.MTAC_MONTH),'YYYYMMDD') AS END_DATE ,CPM.TERM_END_DT AS GYEYAG_IL ,'자동생성' AS MEMO ,'SYSTEM' AS REG_ID FROM crm_cust_project_mgt CPM, CRM_CUST_OPERATE_INFO COI, CRM_CUST_MGT CM WHERE CM.SEQ = CPM.SEQ AND CPM.SEQ NOT IN (SELECT SEQ FROM CRM_VIRTUAL_CONTRACT) AND CPM.SEQ = COI.SEQ AND COI.DEAL_CODE IN ('C001') AND CPM.TERM_END_DT IS NOT NULL AND CPM.MTAC_MONTH IS NOT NULL AND ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CPM.TERM_END_DT),CPM.MTAC_MONTH) > SYSDATE

INSERT INTO CRM_CUST_MAINTENANCE_ADD (VW_PK, CONTRACT_SEQ, CONTRACT_NM, MTAC_CODE, ETC, REG_ID,AUTO_RENEW_YN) SELECT IN_TB.VW_PK, IN_TB.CONTRACT_SEQ ,IN_TB.CONTRACT_NM ,IN_TB.MTAC_CODE ,IN_TB.ETC ,IN_TB.REG_ID ,IN_TB.AUTO_RENEW_YN FROM ( SELECT 'Z'||VC.SEQ||'0' AS VW_PK ,'TBD' AS CONTRACT_SEQ ,'TBD' AS CONTRACT_NM ,'C003' AS MTAC_CODE -- HIS 무상유지보수 ,'자동등록' AS ETC ,'admin' AS REG_ID ,'N' AS AUTO_RENEW_YN FROM crm_virtual_contract VC, CRM_CUST_OPERATE_INFO COI, crm_cust_project_mgt CPM WHERE VC.SEQ = COI.SEQ AND VC.SEQ = CPM.SEQ AND CPM.TERM_END_DT IS NOT NULL AND CPM.MTAC_MONTH IS NOT NULL AND ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CPM.TERM_END_DT),CPM.MTAC_MONTH) > SYSDATE AND COI.DEAL_CODE IN ('C001') )IN_TB WHERE IN_TB.VW_PK NOT IN (SELECT VW_PK FROM CRM_CUST_MAINTENANCE_ADD)

/*[egov-cust-query.xml] custDAO.getErpFreeContract*/ SELECT A.CUST_CODE ,B.CUST_NM -- 거래처명 ,(SELECT Z.BASE_CD_NM FROM KYERP.TB_CM_CODE_DTL Z WHERE Z.BASE_CD_GRP = 'CM0030' AND Z.BASE_CD = A.CONTRACT_KIND) AS CONTRACT_KIND --계약서종류 ,A.CONTRACT_DATE --계약일 ,A.MAINT_ST_DATE ST_DATE --시작일 ,A.MAINT_END_DATE END_DATE --종료일 ,A.MAINT_MONTH_AMT --유지보수금액 ,A.MEMO ,A.CREATE_USER_ID REG_ID --등록자 사번 ,C.EMP_NM REG_NM --등록자명 FROM KYERP.TB_SD_MAINT_MST A ,KYERP.TB_CM_CUSTOMER B ,KYERP.TB_HR_EMPLOYEE C WHERE 1=1 AND A.CUST_CODE = B.CUST_CD (+) AND A.CREATE_USER_ID = C.EMP_CD (+) AND A.CUST_CODE = #{erp_code}

/*[egov-cust-query.xml] custDAO.getErpBill*/ SELECT A.CUST_CODE -- 거래처코드 ,B.CUST_NM -- 거래처명 ,A.CODE_ITEM -- 품목코드 ,D.ITEM_NM -- 품명c ,A.SUPP_AMT + A.VAT AS MAINT_MONTH_AMT --유지보수금액 ,A.GYEYAG_IL CONTRACT_DATE --계약일 ,A.ST_DATE -- 시작일 ,A.END_DATE -- 종료일 ,A.MEMO -- 메모 ,A.SYS_DATE REG_DATE-- 등록일 ,A.SYS_EMP_NO REG_ID --등록자 사번 ,C.EMP_NM REG_NM -- 등록자명 FROM KYERP.TB_FI_AUTO_BILL A ,KYERP.TB_CM_CUSTOMER B ,KYERP.TB_HR_EMPLOYEE C ,KYERP.TB_CM_ITEM_MST D WHERE 1=1 AND A.CUST_CODE = B.CUST_CD (+) AND A.SYS_EMP_NO = C.EMP_CD (+) AND A.CODE_ITEM = D.ITEM_CD (+) AND A.CUST_CODE = #{erp_code} ORDER BY A.CODE_ITEM

/*[egov-cust-query.xml] custDAO.getErpBillHsty*/ SELECT A.CUST_CODE -- 거래처 ,B.CUST_NM -- 거래처명 ,A.CODE_ITEM -- 품목코드 ,D.ITEM_NM -- 품목명 ,A.SUPP_AMT + A.VAT AS MAINT_MONTH_AMT --유지보수금액 ,A.GYEYAG_IL CONTRACT_DATE -- 계약일 ,A.ST_DATE -- 시작일 ,A.END_DATE -- 종료일 ,A.SYS_DATE REG_DATE-- 등록일 ,A.SYS_EMP_NO REG_ID --등록자 사번 ,C.EMP_NM REG_NM--등록자명 FROM KYERP.TB_FI_AUTO_BILL_HSTY A ,KYERP.TB_CM_CUSTOMER B ,KYERP.TB_HR_EMPLOYEE C ,KYERP.TB_CM_ITEM_MST D ,KYERP.TB_FI_AUTO_BILL E WHERE 1=1 AND A.CUST_CODE = B.CUST_CD (+) AND A.SYS_EMP_NO = C.EMP_CD (+) AND A.CODE_ITEM = D.ITEM_CD (+) AND A.PK_SEQ = E.PK_SEQ (+) AND A.CUST_CODE = #{erp_code} ORDER BY A.CODE_ITEM, A.SYS_DATE DESC
